card.text: A star 83% of the Sun's width that turns once in 9.43 days, with a mapped magnetic field.

introduction.text: Folsom et al. give it 0.83 solar radii, 0.9 solar masses, a rotation period of 9.43 days and an axis tilted 67° from the line of sight.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.

radial-field-2015-04.title: Radial field, Apr 2015
radial-field-2015-04.summary: The star's magnetic field, mapped in this project from archived spectra by how it polarises starlight.

brightness-sector-22.title: Brightness map, Sector 22
brightness-sector-22.summary: Darker and brighter longitudes of the star, worked out in this project from how its light changes as it turns.

color-brightness.title: Color + brightness, Feb to Mar 2020
color-brightness.summary: The star in its own color, darker where its light shows it darker; the contrast is drawn stronger to be seen.
